hypotheses.title: Interface-Elimination to DNNF Simulation Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Every polynomial-size finite-gate proof-carrying elimination run satisfying H041 can be transformed in polynomial time into an ordinary DNNF for the original CNF with polynomially related size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Combined with explicit exponential DNNF lower bounds, this would destroy H041 and the surviving exact version of H019.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: convert an underspecified elimination representation into a known lower-bounded language.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove decomposability by induction on certified elimination interfaces or exhibit a valid H041 gate that breaks the translation.
falsification_conditions: A valid H041 elimination family whose functions require superpolynomial DNNF despite polynomial interface DAGs.
A local elimination template violating the proposed decomposable composition invariant.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Local-Lift Communication Lower-Bound Transfer Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For each of the finite local lift models H043-H045, every polynomial-size exact lift with witness recovery induces a polynomial-cost two-party communication protocol for a canonical search relation of the original CNF, with cost polynomial in the lift size and logarithmic in coefficient precision.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: An explicit family with a superpolynomial communication lower bound would simultaneously destroy one or more submodular, TU, and constant-level SoS lift routes.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: expose a common communication invariant behind three constructive P=NP mechanisms.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define one canonical search relation preserved by all three lift semantics and prove the extraction theorem separately for each.
falsification_conditions: A valid local lift whose induced search relation has high communication complexity.
A failure of protocol extraction caused by global auxiliary-variable sharing or real-valued precision.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Explicit Recursive-Extension PC Lower Bound on Hard-DNF Encodings
hypotheses.statement: For a fixed prime p, the Boolean CNF encodings of the hard-DNF tautology candidates underlying H026 require n^omega(1) recursive fan-in-two extension Polynomial Calculus refutations over GF(p), assuming the DNF instances are tautologies.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would select an explicit family for H024, constrain H010/H025/H046, and connect metacomplexity tautologies to a strong algebraic proof lower bound.
hypotheses.proof_role: TARGET_SELECTION: replace an existential extension-PC lower-bound statement by one explicit family already linked to bounded-depth Frege hardness.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove tautologicity first, then transfer the existing constant-depth algebraic hardness to recursively global extension PC.
falsification_conditions: Polynomial-size recursive-extension PC refutations for the exact tautology family.
A falsifying assignment showing the DNF candidates are not tautologies.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Mixed XOR-Random Residual Expansion Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is an explicit polynomial-time constructible CNF family formed from a sparse expander XOR core coupled to a k-DNF-resolution-hard non-affine random-like gadget such that, after every certified affine elimination allowed by H042 or H017, the remaining primal graph has treewidth n^Omega(1) unless the representation grows superpolynomially.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would provide a concrete hard family for H028 and would destroy the parity-core decomposition routes H017 and H042.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: engineer a formula where the affine part is genuinely removable but the residual retains provable expansion.
hypotheses.next_gate: Replace probabilistic existence of the non-affine gadget by an explicit pseudorandom construction and prove closure under affine substitution.
falsification_conditions: A permitted decomposition producing O(log n) residual treewidth and polynomial size.
A proof that affine substitutions destroy the proposed expansion property.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Canonical-CDCL Superpolynomial Conflict Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed polynomial-time branching, restart, and deletion policy of the exact form allowed by H048, there exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible unsatisfiable CNF family on which first-UIP CDCL with polynomial memory requires n^omega(1) conflicts.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would destroy H048 and show that no single canonical policy of that form yields P=NP, while producing a reusable proof-search lower-bound framework.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: quantify uniformly over fixed CDCL policies rather than attack one implementation at a time.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define a policy-description model and diagonalize with a family whose hardness is robust under restarts and learned-clause deletion.
falsification_conditions: A fixed policy satisfying H048 on every CNF.
A theorem that every polynomial-size resolution proof can be found by one fixed policy with polynomial overhead.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Strong Proof-Generator from Constructive Range Avoidance Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a polynomial-time one-bit-stretch circuit generator g and a uniform reduction that converts any infinite NP set disjoint from Range(g) into a polynomial-time solution of a specified general-circuit Range Avoidance instance, contradicting a proved hardness property of that instance class.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would establish H034 for an explicit generator and imply NP != coNP, hence P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: derive a universal proof-complexity generator from a concrete range-avoidance hardness theorem.
hypotheses.next_gate: Choose the generator from a current range-avoidance construction and prove the reduction for arbitrary infinite NP sets.
falsification_conditions: An infinite NP set disjoint from Range(g) whose induced avoidance instances are easy or malformed.
Failure of the reduction to preserve polynomial uniformity or one-bit stretch.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Certified SAT Anti-Checker from Range Avoidance Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: A deterministic polynomial-time reduction maps each general-circuit range-avoidance instance with one-bit output stretch to a polynomial-size certified SAT anti-checker list satisfying H031, with every missing-range witness translated into a checkable SAT circuit error.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Combined with a polynomial-time algorithm for the selected range-avoidance instances, this would construct SAT anti-checkers, prove SAT not in P/poly, and imply P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: turn total-search progress into the concrete anti-checker route H031.
hypotheses.next_gate: Build a bit-by-bit reduction that preserves uniformity and provides certificates for both positive and negative SAT errors.
falsification_conditions: A range-avoidance output whose translation fails to certify an error against any SAT circuit.
A proof that negative SAT errors cannot be certified within the reduction without assuming NP=coNP.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: General Circuit-SAT Self-Improving Speedup Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every constant k there exists epsilon_k>0 and a deterministic algorithm solving SAT for n-input Boolean circuits of size n^k in time 2^n/n^{epsilon_k}, with a uniform description whose overhead satisfies the hypotheses of known self-improvement and algorithmic-lower-bound frameworks.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Self-improvement would amplify the speedup, and the algorithmic method would yield new general or threshold-circuit lower bounds; a sufficiently strong extension to SAT circuits representing NP computations would feed H030 and P != NP routes.
hypotheses.proof_role: ALGORITHMIC_LOWER_BOUND_ROUTE: obtain stronger nonuniform lower bounds from an executable circuit-analysis algorithm.
hypotheses.next_gate: Start with one explicit circuit class beyond current frontiers and prove closure conditions needed for the lower-bound transfer.
falsification_conditions: A matching conditional lower bound ruling out every stated speedup.
A circuit class in the quantifier for which the proposed algorithm provably requires essentially 2^n time under an accepted hypothesis.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Sparse Non-Natural Property for General Circuit Lower Bounds Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial-time decidable property P_n of n-bit truth tables, useful against polynomial-size general Boolean circuits, containing an explicit NP truth-table family, and having density at most 2^{-n^Omega(1)} among all Boolean functions.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Such a sparse constructive useful property would evade the largeness condition of the classical natural-proofs barrier and provide a concrete route toward H030.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: formulate a lower-bound property strong enough for NP but deliberately non-large.
hypotheses.next_gate: Construct the property from range avoidance, unique proofs, or rigid algebraic objects and prove usefulness against every polynomial circuit size.
falsification_conditions: A proof that every polynomial-time decidable useful property containing the candidate NP family must be large.
A polynomial-size circuit family satisfying the property for infinitely many lengths.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Explicit Linear-Map Superlinear Circuit Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a polynomial-time constructible matrix family A_n over a fixed finite field such that computing x -> A_n x requires omega(n polylog n) size in Boolean circuits, or in arithmetic circuits with scalar-product and addition gates under an explicitly fixed model.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would break a fundamental superlinear lower-bound frontier for explicit linear functions and provide a testbed for non-natural methods applicable to stronger general-circuit targets.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: prove a clean explicit lower bound beyond current linear-map barriers before attacking NP-complete functions.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix one circuit model and exhibit a sparse invariant that is useful for A_n but fails the linear-function naturalness condition.
falsification_conditions: A near-linear circuit construction for the selected A_n family.
A theorem that all explicit matrices in the proposed construction class admit O(n polylog n) circuits.
